new_records.title: Group Theory and Three-Dimensional Manifolds
new_records.location: Theorem1.B.5, printedp6; author discussion and references23/24
new_records.original_proof_metadata: A topological proof of Grushko's theorem on free products, Math.Z.90(1965),1-8; DOI10.1007/BF01112046, verified on official Springer page
new_records.audit: Author primary statement read. Rank additivity is derived from its free-group lifting form in the new note. Grushko/Wagner/Neumann credit retained; the original1965 full proof is a classical import and is not independently certified.
new_records.scope: Finite ordinary group rank adds under free products. This supplies the rank step after the explicit lifted-sphere decomposition; it is not a meridional-additivity or full MRC theorem.

new_records.title: Additivity of bridge numbers of knots
new_records.location: Theorem1 and connected-sum argument, author manuscript printedpp4-5; published135(3),539-544
new_records.audit: Primary author manuscript theorem and connected-sum argument read; Cambridge publication metadata checked. Credit to Schubert1954 retained. No independent certification of every geometric foliation lemma or the original1954 proof.
new_records.scope: Bridge number has Schubert(-1)additivity for classical knots. This does not assert general meridional-rank additivity; used for additive nonnegative bridge-minus-cover-bound defects and known controls.

known_controls: Connected sums of T(4,7) have graph-manifold exteriors and are covered by BDJW17, independently of whether the simple-cover lower bound is sharp.
primary_depth: Stallings primary theorem statement and official1965 metadata; Schultens primary theorem and connected-sum argument, geometric lemmas remain imports; BDJW primary class/theorem scopes. No full classical MRC, general meridional additivity or global-priority claim.

live_description_scope_observation.observation: The description credits Pfaff for bridge numbers of13crossing knots, without an explicit all-knots quantifier, named coverage list or certificates on that page. It does not certify closure of the retained named panel. Archived named rows and source-specific certificates remain separate evidence.
